title: Enrich a List of Companies by Domain: Industry, Headcount, Location, Founding Year
summary: How go-to-market teams and their coding agents add firmographics (industry, headcount, location, founding year, LinkedIn page) to a list of company domains with Cargo: one batch call from 0.01 credits a company, misses free, and the next provider only on the gaps.
body_markdown:
**To enrich a go-to-market list of company domains with industry, headcount, location, founding year and LinkedIn page, run one Cargo batch call with` aiArk.enrichCompany` over the domains (0.01 credits per company found, 0 on a miss), then send only the domains it missed to a second provider.**


No AI Ark, Apollo or People Data Labs account is needed: Cargo calls each provider on its own key and bills credits. The steps below use the Cargo CLI, so a coding agent can run them end to end, and they are what the[enrich-company-data](https://www.getcargo.ai/skills/enrich-company-data) skill does.


## What 2.4M company lookups show#


Cargo platform data, 90 days to Oct 16 2026:


Measure Value


Company enrichment runs 2,454,228


Workspaces running them 210


Runs that returned a company 91.6%


Runs that found nothing and were charged 0 credits on 99.8% of those


That is more runs than email verification or person enrichment over the same 90 days.


## The actions and what they cost#


Each price is the list price in credits from the action’s definition in Cargo’s code, charged only when the action returns a company.


Action Credits per company found Input


` aiArk.enrichCompany` 0.01` domain` , or` linkedinUrl` (company page)


` companyEnrich.enrichByDomain` 0.25` domain`


` linkedin.enrichCompanyFromDomain` 0.5` domain`


` apolloio.enrichOrganization` 1` domain` , or` linkedin_url` ,` name` or` website`


` peopleDataLabs.enrichCompany` 3` parameters.website` , or other` parameters` such as` name`


At 0.01 credits, 1,000 companies found on AI Ark cost 10 credits. A new account starts with 100 free credits and no card.


## Run it#


### 1. Install and sign in


shellscript


```text
npm   install   -g   @cargo-ai/cli
cargo-ai   login   --email   you@company.com                   # sends a code
cargo-ai   login   --email   you@company.com   --code   123456     # creates the account on first use


```


There is no browser step, so a coding agent can run this itself.


### 2. Pilot on 5 rows


` --limit 5` submits only the first five records, so you can read the output and the cost before the full run.


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   execute-batch   \
--action   '{"kind":"connector","integrationSlug":"aiArk","actionSlug":"enrichCompany"}'   \
--records   '[{"domain":"acme.com"},{"domain":"globex.com"}]'   \
--limit   5   --wait-until-finished


```


The examples on this page leave out the` connectorUuid` an action object may carry, in which case Cargo uses the workspace’s default connector for that provider.` cargo-ai orchestration action list enrich company` shows the action objects and their prices without running anything.


### 3. Run the full list, then fill the gaps


Drop` --limit` to run every domain. Download the results with` cargo-ai orchestration batch download --uuid <batch uuid>` , keep the domains that came back empty, and send only those to the next provider:


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   execute-batch   \
--action   '{"kind":"connector","integrationSlug":"linkedin","actionSlug":"enrichCompanyFromDomain"}'   \
--records   "$(  cat   misses.json)"   \
--wait-until-finished


```


` companyEnrich.enrichByDomain` and` linkedin.enrichCompanyFromDomain` take the same` {"domain": "..."}` record. People Data Labs nests its input:` {"parameters": {"website": "acme.com"}}` . Never send the full list to every provider: a second provider charges again for a company already enriched.


## What comes back#


The firmographic fields, and where each action puts them:


Field` aiArk.enrichCompany`` companyEnrich.enrichByDomain`` linkedin.enrichCompanyFromDomain`` apolloio.enrichOrganization`


Name` name`` name`` company_name`` organization.name`


Industry` industry` ,` industries\[\]`` industry` ,` industries\[\]`` industries\[\]`` organization.industry`


Headcount` employee_count`` employees` (a range)` employee_count` ,` employee_range`` organization.estimated_num_employees`


Location` city` ,` state` ,` country`` location.city.name` ,` location.country.name`` hq_city` ,` hq_region` ,` hq_country`` organization.city` ,` organization.country`


Founding year` founded_year`` founded_year`` year_founded`` organization.founded_year`


LinkedIn page` linkedin_url`` socials.linkedin_url`` linkedin_url`` organization.linkedin_url`


Also` revenue` ,` technologies\[\]` ,` naics\[\]`` revenue` ,` technologies\[\]` ,` financial.total_funding`` follower_count` ,` specialties` ,` funding_info`` organization.organization_revenue_printed` ,` organization.naics_codes\[\]`


` peopleDataLabs.enrichCompany` returns` name` ,` industry` ,` size` ,` employee_count` ,` founded` ,` location.locality` ,` location.country` ,` linkedin_url` and` inferred_revenue` .


A domain with no match comes back with no data and is not charged.` cargo-ai orchestration action get-output-schema --action '<action object>'` prints any action’s output schema without running it.


## Keep it running#


A one-off list is a batch call. To keep a CRM’s accounts filled as they arrive, the[crm-enrichment](https://www.getcargo.ai/cookbooks/crm-enrichment) cookbook deploys the account path as a play, with` linkedin.enrichCompanyFromDomain` as its domain route. To build the list of accounts in the first place, see the[tam-building](https://www.getcargo.ai/cookbooks/tam-building) cookbook.


Once the companies are enriched,[turn LinkedIn profile URLs into person profiles and work emails](https://www.getcargo.ai/blog/linkedin-profile-url-to-person-profile-and-work-email) for the people at them.


## Frequently asked questions#


No. A company enrichment action that finds no company returns no data, and no credits are charged. In Cargo platform data for the 90 days to Oct 16 2026, 99.8% of company enrichment runs that found nothing were charged 0 credits.


The cheapest one, then the next only on its misses. aiArk.enrichCompany costs 0.01 credits per company found, so a full first pass over 10,000 domains costs at most 100 credits, and the pricier providers only see the gaps.


No. Unless you connect your own key, Cargo calls the provider on Cargo’s key and bills the action’s credits. If you already pay Apollo or People Data Labs, you can connect your key instead.
